title: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP <= 2500ms) Across Mobile & Desktop
description: Core Web Vitals 2026 requirement: the render time of the largest visible image, video poster, or block-level text element in the initial viewport (LCP) must not exceed 2500ms (2.5 seconds) across mobile (375x812) and desktop (1440x900) viewports. The primary above-the-fold hero image must specify `fetchpriority="high"` and must NOT use `loading="lazy"`.
playwright_check_snippet: const lcp = window.__webVitals?.lcp_ms ?? 0; const heroImg = document.querySelector('main img, header img, img'); const lazyHero = heroImg && heroImg.getAttribute('loading') === 'lazy' && heroImg.getBoundingClientRect().top < window.innerHeight; return (lcp <= 2500 && !lazyHero) ? 'APPLIED_PASS' : 'VIOLATED_FAIL';
vision_prompt_heuristic: Inspect the above-the-fold hero section. Verify that the primary hero image or headline renders completely without broken media placeholders or unstyled flash of text.
remediation_guide: Add `fetchpriority="high"` and remove `loading="lazy"` on the primary above-the-fold LCP image, serve AVIF/WebP formats, preload critical hero assets via `<link rel="preload" as="image">`, and keep server TTFB `< 600ms`.

title: Interaction to Next Paint (INP <= 200ms) — Main-Thread Responsiveness
description: Core Web Vitals 2026 requirement: latency from a user click, tap, or keypress to the next visual frame presented by the browser (INP) must not exceed 200ms. Main-thread JavaScript tasks (Long Animation Frames / Long Tasks) must yield within 50ms.
vision_prompt_heuristic: Verify that interactive elements provide clean visual state transitions on focus and interaction without layout freeze or jank.
remediation_guide: Yield long event handlers using `scheduler.yield()` or `setTimeout(..., 0)`, wrap non-urgent UI updates in React `startTransition`, and keep total DOM size below `1500` nodes.

title: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS < 0.1) — Visual Layout Stability
description: Core Web Vitals 2026 requirement: the cumulative layout shift score (CLS) must be strictly less than 0.1. All images, video elements, iframes, ad slots, and asynchronous containers must declare explicit `width` and `height` attributes or CSS `aspect-ratio` so late-loading assets or web fonts never shift interactive controls under the user's pointer.
playwright_check_snippet: const cls = window.__webVitals?.cls_score ?? 0; const imgsWithoutDims = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('img')).filter(img => !img.hasAttribute('width') && !img.hasAttribute('height') && getComputedStyle(img).aspectRatio === 'auto'); return (cls < 0.1 && imgsWithoutDims.length === 0) ? 'APPLIED_PASS' : 'VIOLATED_FAIL';
vision_prompt_heuristic: Inspect the page layout for any overlapping banners, unreserved image containers, or late-injected top bars that push page content down.
